description: Conversion of garage to habitable room, Replace garage door with window in front elevation
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal">The proposed garage
conversion, including the replacement window to the front elevation, by reason of inappropriate and unsympathetic design, would result in an unduly
obtrusive and incongruous addition that would poorly relate to the existing fenestration
details to the front elevation of the host property and would give rise to a loss of symmetry and uniformity to the row of terraced dwellings in this part of Lady Aylesford Avenue.&nbsp; The proposal would therefore detract from the
character and appearance of the row of terrace properties containing the subject site and the surrounding area and would unacceptably harm the character of the original dwellinghouse
and the character of the area, contrary to the high quality design
aspirations set out in The National Planning Policy Framework (2024), policies
D3 (D(1) and D(11)) of The London Plan (2021), Policy CS1.B on the Harrow Core
Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Development Management Local Plans Policies
(2013),&nbsp; emerging policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan and Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>
